independence_note: The converter uses stdlib XML parsing and builds source-ordered TEI; the oracle uses lxml and independently traverses the retained source, scandata, PDF and actual TEI. Both read the same scan-bound correction map and DjVuXML witness. The oracle independently checks exact source carriers, map bindings, transformations and output structure, but it is not a second blind reading of every scan glyph.
known_limitations: Every access-format scan page has a recorded visual-review disposition and scan-verified corrections are applied, but the review is not a glyph-by-glyph transcription of every OCR word. Uncorrected OCR wording remains the retained witness and may contain unobserved recognition errors.
Six access pages (3, 4, 6, 10, 14, 133) contain no OCR WORD elements. Their page carriers remain, but image-only text is not transcribed.
The empty LINE on page 2, paragraph 2 has no WORD element; it is preserved as source structure, not interpreted as text.

Internet Archive item metadata has no rights or license URL fields. Acquisition records source identity only; rights clearance, human acceptance, canonical integration, and publication are unresolved.

mapping_policy.empty_ocr: Keep all six zero-word pages as explicit page carriers and identify their OCR gaps in accounting; no text is inferred from the scan.
mapping_policy.excluded: Account for, but exclude, non-access Color Card leaves 0 and 137 from literary TEI.
mapping_policy.corrections: Apply only exact source-carrier corrections confirmed in the versioned scan-corrections.v1.json map. Record the source OCR form, scan reading, location, raw WORD text, and coordinates in source accountability. The retained OCR remains immutable; comparison OCR is never merged into reading text.
mapping_policy.layout: Represent the page-13 contents as seven structured chapter/title/page entries; represent the two-column indexes and bibliography on pages 126-132 as ordered source-column divisions. Preserve marginal headings as scan-grounded notes attached to their source page and paragraph.
mapping_policy.pages: Create one scan-page division in source order for each of the 136 access-format PDF/DjVuXML pages and retain source leaf/page labels and PDF target.
mapping_policy.sections: Represent pages 1-14 as front matter; pages 15-125 as seven source-led chapters; pages 126-136 as back matter. Explicit source headings are encoded in place; uncertain lines remain OCR paragraphs.
mapping_policy.support: Bind all eight retained source/evidence files. The provider receipt and complete inventory account for the unselected provider derivatives and support members; comparison OCR is not silently merged into reading text.
mapping_policy.text: Preserve DjVuXML wording and order except for the exact scan-grounded corrections and structural carrier moves listed in the correction map. Concatenate retained source WORD text in each source LINE order; page, paragraph, and line carriers remain explicitly accounted. Preserve empty source paragraphs and lines.
mapping_policy.work_boundary: The scan presents one complete top-level titled book, including front matter, seven chapters, indexes, bibliography, and appended scan pages; emit exactly one candidate TEI for this one complete work.
mapping_policy.visual_review: Record direct or independent visual inspection of every access-format PDF page in the correction map. This whole-page pass does not claim exhaustive glyph-by-glyph comparison; corrections require exact scan support, and uncertain handwriting or image-only text remains explicitly unresolved.

empty_structural_carriers.disposition: preserve the source paragraph and empty line carrier in TEI
